original_query: with inv as (select w_warehouse_name,w_warehouse_sk,i_item_sk,d_moy        ,stdev,mean, case mean when 0 then null else stdev/mean end cov  from(select w_warehouse_name,w_warehouse_sk,i_item_sk,d_moy             ,stddev_samp(inv_quantity_on_hand) stdev,avg(inv_quantity_on_hand) mean       from inventory           ,item           ,warehouse           ,date_dim       where inv_item_sk = i_item_sk         and inv_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk         and inv_date_sk = d_date_sk         and d_year =2001         and i_category IN ('Shoes', 'Sports')         and i_manager_id BETWEEN 81 and 100         and inv_quantity_on_hand between 30 and 230       group by w_warehouse_name,w_warehouse_sk,i_item_sk,d_moy) foo  where case mean when 0 then 0 else stdev/mean end > 1) select inv1.w_warehouse_sk,inv1.i_item_sk,inv1.d_moy,inv1.mean, inv1.cov         ,inv2.w_warehouse_sk,inv2.i_item_sk,inv2.d_moy,inv2.mean, inv2.cov from inv inv1,inv inv2 where inv1.i_item_sk = inv2.i_item_sk   and inv1.w_warehouse_sk =  inv2.w_warehouse_sk   and inv1.d_moy=1   and inv2.d_moy=1+1   and inv1.cov > 1.5 order by inv1.w_warehouse_sk,inv1.i_item_sk,inv1.d_moy,inv1.mean,inv1.cov         ,inv2.d_moy,inv2.mean, inv2.cov ;
rewritten_query:
SELECT
    s.w_warehouse_sk,
    s.i_item_sk,
    1 AS d_moy,
    s.mean_1 AS mean,
    s.cov_1 AS cov,
    s.w_warehouse_sk,
    s.i_item_sk,
    2 AS d_moy,
    s.mean_2 AS mean,
    s.cov_2 AS cov
FROM (
    SELECT
        m.w_warehouse_sk,
        m.i_item_sk,
        m.mean_1,
        m.mean_2,
        CASE WHEN m.mean_1 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE m.stdev_1 / m.mean_1 END AS cov_1,
        CASE WHEN m.mean_2 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE m.stdev_2 / m.mean_2 END AS cov_2
    FROM (
        SELECT
            w.w_warehouse_sk,
            i.i_item_sk,
            stddev_samp(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) FILTER (WHERE d.d_moy = 1) AS stdev_1,
            avg(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) FILTER (WHERE d.d_moy = 1) AS mean_1,
            stddev_samp(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) FILTER (WHERE d.d_moy = 2) AS stdev_2,
            avg(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) FILTER (WHERE d.d_moy = 2) AS mean_2
        FROM inventory inv
        JOIN item i
          ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        JOIN warehouse w
          ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
        JOIN date_dim d
          ON inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        WHERE d.d_year = 2001
          AND d.d_moy IN (1, 2)
          AND i.i_category IN ('Shoes', 'Sports')
          AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 81 AND 100
          AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand BETWEEN 30 AND 230
        GROUP BY
            w.w_warehouse_sk,
            i.i_item_sk
    ) m
) s
WHERE s.cov_1 > 1.5
  AND s.cov_2 > 1
ORDER BY
    s.w_warehouse_sk,
    s.i_item_sk,
    s.mean_1,
    s.cov_1,
    s.mean_2,
    s.cov_2;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Pushed d_moy filter into the base aggregation: only months 1 and 2 are needed, so computing aggregates over all 12 months then filtering is ~6x wasted work on the 133M-row inventory fact. Constant '1+1' folded to 2.

Eliminated the materialized CTE 'inv' and its self-join. The CTE was referenced twice, forcing materialization of all-month aggregates followed by a self-join. Replaced with a single-pass conditional aggregation (FILTER) that computes month-1 and month-2 statistics per (warehouse, item) in one group.

Removed w_warehouse_name from GROUP BY since the final SELECT never uses it and w_warehouse_sk is the primary key of warehouse (functionally dependent). Converted comma joins to explicit ANSI INNER JOINs for clearer join ordering.

Replaced the CTE self-join (inv1 d_moy=1 JOIN inv2 d_moy=2) with FILTER-based pivot aggregation grouped by (w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk), requiring HAVING-style conditions cov_1 > 1.5 AND cov_2 > 1, which preserves the original CTE cov > 1 filter plus the cov_1 > 1.5 condition.
inv2.d_moy = 1+1 folded to 2; d_moy constants are output directly as literals 1 and 2 in the result, preserving original ORDER BY semantics (constant sort keys removed).
